decisions: Native triggers are 36px with 10px corners; content cards use 8px corners,8/16px inset,4px gap and 14/20 Medium title/description. The native description text field says Medium despite its Regular style label, so this reference explicitly keeps the observed Medium field and muted role. Native 290px card width becomes a preferred maximum. Popup 12px corner/1px border/4px content pad are explicit reference surface choices; source 350ms position/size/content opacity timing is retained with reduced-motion duration 0.01ms; source Positioner/Popup width/height/origin variables remain actual measured geometry. Root automatically appends one Positioner; no extra default instance is added. Source Root and private Popup are native navigation landmarks, not menu roles; the private popup has no invented label prop. Active/current-page link and open disclosure value remain distinct. Destination links choose closeOnClick=true in target, while the source default remains false. Root/Trigger keyboard, disabled focusability, hover delay and controlled cancellation retain pinned primitive rules. Theme/dir are document context because the built-in private Popup cannot receive arbitrary Root data-theme props. Trigger aria-controls identifies the actual private nav Popup, not its Content child. No page/frame/node selectors or fixed source sample positions survive.

Semantic token scalar values are meaningful reusable metrics, never coordinate-keyed specimen dimensions. Widths in native specimen grids remain evidence unless explicitly adopted as a domain layout constraint.
